meta.name: storyboard-creation
meta.description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将视频创意转化为分镜脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为视频或动画项目绘制专业分镜
copy.tagline_en: Turn video ideas into storyboard panels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create professional storyboards for video or animation projects

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成电影分镜图，包括镜头类型、角度、运动、连续性规则和面板布局，并输出带注释的分镜板。
howto.when: 当你提到“分镜”、“故事板”、“镜头列表”、“电影规划”、“视频规划”、“前期制作”、“镜头构图”、“摄像机角度”、“场景规划”、“视觉脚本”、“动态分镜”、“分镜面板”、“视频分镜”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个电影分镜，场景是办公室，主角在桌前看信。
say.note: Claude 会生成一系列分镜面板并拼接成板。

say.text: 列出5个镜头，包括特写和中景，用于广告分镜。
say.note: Claude 会输出镜头列表并生成对应图像。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate film storyboard panels based on your description, including shot types, camera angles, movement, continuity rules, and panel layout, and output annotated storyboard boards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard.

say_en.text: Generate a storyboard for an office scene where the protagonist reads a letter at a desk.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a series of panels and stitch them into a board.

say_en.text: List 5 shots including close-up and medium shot for an ad storyboard.
say_en.note: Claude will output a shot list and generate corresponding images.
